channel.title: Adstart — TikTok Ads guide
channel.description: Independent guide to getting started with TikTok Ads: new advertiser ad credits, registration steps and first-campaign setup in Ads Manager. Available in English, Spanish (Mexico), Indonesian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian.

item.title: Get started with TikTok Ads: account, ad credits and first campaign
item.description: New advertiser ad credit tiers, the three steps of registration on TikTok and what to decide before your first spend. Includes a FAQ on cost, credits and affiliation. Now also in Spanish (Mexico), Indonesian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian.
